title: Regular Beach
description: Regular Beach is a brand, arts collective and media library building community in design and visual arts among other things. Visit the website to view ongoing projects.

title: Proof Lab Site
description: Shopify site and studio photography for Proof Lab Surf Shop working closely with owner Will Hutchinson. after launching in early December '25, the site is being slowly built upon to reinforce Proof Lab's brand and community involvement. Thank you Mike McKay for photography consulting.

title: Hendrix Park
description: Hendrix Park is a one-person sewing studio making clothing with vintage industrial machines in Sausalito, CA. Hendrix Park has no desire for a rigid identity system. They like the brand to be a flexible and evolving collection of fun assets, just like their products! This is an ongoing collaboration that has included a custom shopify site, woven Label graphics, screenprinted hangtags & more.

title: Weather Report
description: 19x30in poster design for Mackenzie Huber and July Guzman's collaborative art show featuring new work at the Bolinas Gallery. The artists did not wish to feature their work as imagery for the design. Instead, objects relating to their concept were sourced and photographed for this project. A short animated version was made for social media.

title: Walk St. Helena
description: NG2 was approached by St. Helena Community members to design a 100 page report outlining improvements for walking trails and open space in the City of St. Helena. A straightforward visual identity and graphic approach was developed to structure this document. This project was created in collaboration with David Knudsen along with several other community members- with oversite given by experienced landscape architect Joe Runco (SWA Group).

title: Groundworks Office
description: Graphic design production for Groundworks Office Landscape Architecture marketing pursuits, creating extensive qualifications packages following existing brand guidelines. All content and photography developed by Groundworks Office. Reach out for more information.

title: Shakespeare on the Water
description: Rebranding and event graphics for a Sausalito theater company hosting various programming and workshops.

title: The Farm Diary
description: Web design and development for a portfolio which documents 5 years of managing and restoring a historic vineyard property in Sonoma, CA. Password required for full access. Please contact for permissions.

title: ZMDF
description: Identity System for Zac Mosher Design & Fabrication (ZMDF).
